outline:
本課程的重點在於闡述統計學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋三個領域：敘述統計、機率理論與推論統計，其中包含概念介紹、敘述統計、機率理論、推論統計。另有統計學的應用領域於推論未知的情況以作為相關決策之依據，並包含統計軟體使用介紹。
The purpose of Statistics is to give students an introductory of statistical thinking, methods development and the assessment of credibility and value of inferences made from data. A conceptual introduction to the field of statistics and its many applications with extensive coverage of data collection and analysis as needed to evaluate the reported results of statistical students and make a good decision will be included as well. The statistical software introduction will also be introduced in the class.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction of the Course
Week 2: What Is Statistics
Week 3: Describing Data: Frequency Tables, Frequency Distributions, and Graphic Presentation（Ｉ）
Week 4: Describing Data: Frequency Tables, Frequency Distributions, and Graphic Presentation（ＩＩ）
Week 5: Describing Data: Numerical Measures　（Ｉ）
Week 6: Describing Data: Numerical Measures　（ＩＩ）
Week 7: Describing Data: Displaying and Exploring Data（Ｉ）
Week 8: Describing Data: Displaying and Exploring Data　（Ｉ）
Week 9: Midterm exam
Week 10: A Survey of Probability Concepts　（Ｉ）
Week 11: A Survey of Probability Concepts　（ＩＩ）
Week 12: Discrete Probability Distributions　（Ｉ）
Week 13: Discrete Probability Distributions　（ＩＩ）
Week 14: Continuous Probability Distributions（Ｉ）
Week 15: Continuous Probability Distributions（ＩＩ）
Week 16: Sampling, Sampling Methods, and the Central Limit Theorem（Ｉ）
Week 17: Sampling, Sampling Methods, and the Central Limit Theorem（ＩＩ）
Week 18: Final exam
materials: DOUGLAS A. LIND, WILLIAM G. MARCHAL & SAMUEL A. WATHEN, BASIC STATISTICS FOR BUSINESS AND ECONOMICS, 10th ed., McGraw-Hill Publisher Inc.
consultation:
1.If students have any questions, students can ask directly during the class time
2.If students have any questions, students can make an appointment to discuss by e-mail．
